name: CapitaLand China Trust
summary: CapitaLand China Trust (CLCT) is Singapore's largest China-focused real estate investment trust (REIT). CLCT's portfolio comprises eight shopping malls, five business park properties and four logistics park properties. Its total property value is S4.3 billion dollars based on valuations of its proportionate interests in the portfolio as at 31 December 2025. The geographically diversified portfolio has a total gross floor area of approximately 1.7 million square metres, located across 11 leading Chinese cities.
